name: Xero
summary: Xero charges by connections: free up to 5, Core (50) needs a payment method, Plus (1,000) adds App Certification, Advanced (10,000) adds a security assessment. Data from Xero's APIs may not be used to train AI/ML models.

toggles.label: How many Xero organisations will connect?

gates.title: Create an app in the Xero developer portal
gates.nextStep: At developer.xero.com → My Apps → New app (Web app), add the redirect URI https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback.

gates.title: Subscribe to the plan that covers your connections

blockers.symptom: Connections stop at the plan maximum
blockers.fix: Move up a plan and meet its prerequisites: payment method from Core, App Certification from Plus, security assessment from Advanced.

gates.nextStep: Add a payment method in the Xero developer portal and choose the plan that covers your expected connections (Core up to 50, Plus up to 1,000).

gates.title: Accept the developer terms (no training AI/ML models on Xero data)

blockers.symptom: Your product trains AI/ML models on data from Xero's APIs
blockers.fix: Not allowed. Keep Xero data out of any training set; an agent acting through the API is a separate question to confirm in the terms.

gates.nextStep: Read Xero's developer terms (developer.xero.com/xero-developer-platform-terms-conditions) with whoever owns legal. Xero publishes an AI toolkit, so agents acting through the API are an intended use; confirm no clause limits yours, and never train models on Xero data.

requirements.label: Payment method on the Xero developer account
howToGet: Add a card to your Xero developer account

requirements.label: Xero App Certification
howToGet: Xero lists App Certification as a prerequisite from the Plus plan; start it from the Xero developer portal before you pass 50 connections.
requirements.whatToAsk: Ask Xero developer support: "How long does App Certification take today, and what does it check?"

claims.text: From 2 Mar 2026: Starter 5 connections free; Core 50 connections A$35; Plus 1,000 A$245; Advanced 10,000 A$1,445; Enterprise by arrangement.

sources.quote: Starter 5 conns free · Core 50 A$35/mo · Plus 1,000 A$245 · Advanced 10,000 A$1,445 · Enterprise POA.

claims.text: A payment method is needed from the Core tier.
Connections are capped at the tier maximums until you meet that tier's requirements.

sources.quote: Connections are capped at the tier maximums until you meet that tier's requirements.

claims.text: Third-party docs mention 25 uncertified connections; Xero's 2026 pages do not.
claims.note: Treat the 25 as pre-March-2026; the plan uses the 2026 tiers.

claims.text: Data obtained from Xero's APIs may not be used to train AI/ML models.
